methodology.notes: Custom text submission for the airline domain only. Agent LLM was cerebras/gpt-oss-120b via Cerebras. The run used a ByteVerity custom deterministic controller around the tau2 airline tools for task-state tracking, policy and operand validation, action gating, and verified completion. All 50 airline base tasks were run for 4 trials with no task filters. The CLI cost field is tau2 avg_agent_cost for the agent side only; the observed raw total run cost including user simulator cost was 3.863 USD across 200 simulations.

verification.details: Custom agent harness/controller and agent-side prompts differed from the default tau2 scaffold. User simulator model and task set were unchanged; no airline tasks were omitted.
